hooks.command: PROTECTED=main; B=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$B" = "$PROTECTED" ]; then TS=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S); NB="claude/${TS}-$$"; git checkout -b "$NB" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "Feature-Branch erstellt: $NB"; fi; exit 0

PROTECTED=main; B=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$B" = "$PROTECTED" ] || [ -z "$B" ]; then exit 0; fi; AHEAD=$(git rev-list --count "origin/$PROTECTED..$B" 2>/dev/null || git rev-list --count "$PROTECTED..$B" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "${AHEAD:-0}" -eq 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; git push -u origin "$B" 2>&1 | tail -3; if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then EX=$(gh pr list --head "$B" --json number -q 'length' 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "${EX:-0}" = "0" ]; then gh pr create --fill --base "$PROTECTED" 2>&1 | tail -3; fi; fi; exit 0
